description: Shared prompt set for REC-LEG-001 (legacy Bedrock vs new LangGraph engine comparison, plan §4.10). Categories follow §3.8's golden-eval-set list so this set can grow into that one rather than being thrown away.

prompts.text: I need something warm and cozy for a rainy afternoon.
אני רוצה משהו אנרגטי לריצת בוקר.
A mix of jazz and electronic, something smooth but still danceable.
More songs like Bon Iver and Sufjan Stevens.
Give me some deep house tracks.
Surprise me with something outside my usual indie folk taste.
Upbeat pop, but nothing with heavy autotune.
משהו במקצב של רוק ישראלי קלאסי.
Hip hop mixed with soul, in English please.
Chill acoustic music, but nothing that sounds like a coffee-shop cliche.
